question: Ticket dc6fab168f28 says 'OpenAIWireHandler (a machine class in openai_wire) inherits from DiagnosticBase as its first base', but outline 17.1.3.5 reads "The base classes all inherit from base, and so bring its logging, diagnostics and core patterns with them:" (17.1.3.5 states 'The base classes all inherit from base' and lists only three: base device, base shim, base proxy. Machines are not identified as base classes in the outline (see 1.3.2). Making a machine class inherit from base contradicts the outlined restriction that only the three specified base classes inherit from base to bring diagnostics.). Which stands, the ticket or the outline?
why_it_blocks: the ticket and the component outline disagree; building it would build one of them wrong
answer: The ticket stands. 17.1.3.5 says the three base classes inherit from base; it does not say only they do. 17.1.2 says diagnostics are written once and inherited everywhere, and ticket 339a45cee6a1 records Akien's 2026-10-27 ruling that any class with code in it can run a diagnostic report, and that everybody inherits the mixin. The other five tickets in this batch carry the same change and their outline checks found no conflict.
